app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

azure_firewall.description: Define existing Azure firewall Name and Resource Group. Check example in .test/deployTest folder for more details

azurerm_disk_encryption_set.type: object({ name = string encryption_type = string auto_key_rotation_enabled = bool })

client_id.description: SPN client ID. Fetched from DX1 vault

client_secret.description: SPN client Secret. Fetched from DX1 vault

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

deploy_acr_and_privateendpoint.description: Enable this to Deploy ACR and private endpoint for it

deploy_istio.description: Enable this setting to deploy Istio Service Mesh. Default is 'false'

deploy_keda.description: Enable this setting to deploy Keda. Default is 'false'

deploy_nginx_ingress.description: Enable this setting to deploy Nginx Ingress Controller. Default is 'false'

deploy_private_dns_zone_vnet_link.description: Deploy Virtual network link for Routable Vnet

dx1_pat_token.description: DX1 User Personal Access Token Value

dx1_user.description: DX1 User Personal Access Token Name

enable_artifactory.description: Enable this setting to use Artifactory registry for istio, keda and nginx images. Default is 'false'

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

gitops_aks_common_repo_reference.description: GitOps common repo reference type, can be branch or tag

gitops_aks_common_repo_version.description: Always use tag revisions for all environments.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

node_resource_group.description: (Optional) Custom name for the AKS node resource group. Required for regions with long CLI names (e.g. germanywestcentral) to prevent exceeding Azure's 80-character resource group name limit. If not set, Azure auto-generates the name as MC_{resource_group}_{cluster_name}_{location}.

pe_subnet_id.description: Subnet ID for use by Private Endpoints

subscription_id.description: Subscription ID where resources will be deployed

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

time_delay.description: Added Time delay for RBAC sync

aks_name.description: The name of the AKS Cluster

aks_resource.description: Resource details of the AKS cluster

oidc_issuer_url.description: The OIDC Issuer URL of the AKS cluster. Used for federated credential integration with Azure AD Workload Identity.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Aks Private' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
